_comment: Add one object per episode, newest anywhere (build sorts by date). show_type must be one of: Tuesday Rankings, Thursday Picks, Sunday Update, Sunday Recap. mp3 is relative to base_url (put the file in public/episodes/). duration is HH:MM:SS. bytes = file size (build fills it in automatically if the mp3 exists in public/).

episodes.title: Week 3 2026 Sunday Recap — Vector 3-0 Best Bets, Claude Leads the AIs
episodes.description: Catch-up Sunday Recap for the missed post-SNF slot: Vector Best Bets went 3-0 (+3U) on CHI +4.5, PIT +3.5, and DEN +2.5, with Monday night Chicago 27–Philadelphia 7 sealing the card. Claude led the AI panel (10-5 sides, +2.5U, pick-5 5-0); Gemini and Grok were near even; ChatGPT lagged. SuperContest after Week 3 is topped at 13.00 (13-2) by Hitman, Rigged, and Seans Dolphins.
